BÆRSkin Supports The Fallen Outdoors Veteran Program

The Fallen Outdoors is an all-Veteran volunteer 501(c)(3) that connects Veterans to each other and to the great outdoors. The BÆRSkin Tactical Supply Co is proud to be able to support its incredible work by donating outdoor apparel to Veterans who want to reconnect with nature. The Fallen Outdoors is able to provide outdoor opportunities for Veterans, at no cost, thanks to donations and support from their communities.

BÆRSkin Supports Hope for the Warriors Veterans Charity

Hope For The Warriors is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to restoring self, family, and HOPE for post-9/11 Veterans, service members, and military families. BÆRSkin Tactical Supply Co is proud to support its mission by donating high-quality outerwear to those who have sacrificed for our country. Through innovative programs, Hope For The Warriors provides critical support, helping these heroes regain strength, purpose, and connection. Thanks to donations and community support, they continue to make a lasting impact.

  • Hiking-Grade Waterproof: 20k Waterproof rating with 2.5 layer design, taped seams, protective outer shell + BÆR-Tex water repellent coating.
  • Packs Down Small: Folds tight into its own pocket (easily fits in your backpack), ultra-light and flexible for spring showers or heavy rain.
  • RAIN-SULATION Design: Adjustable toggles on the wrists, waist and hood to seal every inch and keep you bone dry in sideways rain.

Rain Cancelled Your Plans? This Jacket Cancels Rain.

Rain Cancelled Your Plans? This Jacket Cancels Rain.

Unexpected rain can ruin a nice day out - so you need to make sure you have a packable rain jacket on hand.

That's why we designed the BÆRSkin Heavy-Storm Rain Jacket 2.0 to insulate your clothes like a dry-storage vault. Every zip is sealed. Every stitch is taped with silicone. Engineered with our proprietary BÆR-Tex Water Repellent Coating.

  • 20,000mm Waterproof Rating allows this jacket to keep you 100% dry even in heavier storms.
  • Secure Dry Storage no matter how hard it rains, from a shower to a downright storm.
  • Waterproof Central Zip is sealed to perfection with a hidden storm flap to lock out the worst rain.

The Heavy-Duty Packable Rain Jacket That's Light & Versatile for Fishing, Golf, Hunting, Camping or Boating.

Get the ultimate rain jacket for extreme performance in light or heavy rain - that's still light, packable and flexible enough to wear for any activity.

BÆR-Tex Water Repellent Coating

20,000mm waterproof rating to stay dry when you're commuting, cycling, camping or hiking in sudden rain storms.

RAIN-SULATION Design

Fully adjustable waist, wrists and hood for perfect insulation when the wind gets nasty too - no more leaks in sideways rain!

Folds Away Into a Pocket

Our jacket folds into its own stash pocket, making it highly packable without taking up extra space in your backpack.

Zips into the BÆRSkin Hoodie

Features a two-zip system which allows the inner zip of the rain jacket to attach to the new BÆRSkin Hoodie.

Zips into The BÆRSkin Hoodie for the Ultimate 3-in-1 Waterproof Outdoor Hoodie.

Zips into The BÆRSkin Hoodie for the Ultimate 3-in-1 Waterproof Outdoor Hoodie.

The brand new two-zip system of the Heavy-Storm Rain Jacket allows you to attach the BÆRSkin Hoodie to the inner zip of the Heavy-Storm Rain Jacket- while the outer waterproof zip seals the entire garment to create a 3-in-1 Waterproof Outdoor Hoodie that perfect for getting work done outdoors.

  • Easily attach the BÆRSkin Hoodie to the inner zip.
  • Use the outer zip to seal in the rain jacket and protect your hoodie.
  • Feel the snug warmth of 340gsm of BÆRSkin MicroFleece on the inside of your Rain Jacket.

This allows your BÆRSkin Hoodie to become a breathable mid-layer that prevents "wet out" while your Heavy-Storm Rain Jacket sends water droplets running!

Stay Mobile, Stay Dry — Stay Ready.

Stay Mobile, Stay Dry — Stay Ready.

On top of the water-repellent excellence, this jacket is made with 100% Polyester Ripstop Fabric - prevents tears, rips, and stops your jacket from absorbing dirt & mud.

So, what does RAIN-SULATION mean?

  • Adjustable wrist + waist toggles to seal out the wind and rain.
  • 100% Waterproof front zip and storm flap that's 100% watertight, sealed with silicone.
  • Fully adjustable hood with a brim to shield your eyes, stays tight and never allows water in your face.

Lab-Tested. Free from PFAS & "Forever Chemicals".

Lab-Tested. Free from PFAS & "Forever Chemicals".

Most outdoor brands use PFAS in their water-repellent coating. PFAS are a group of synthetic chemicals, often called "forever chemicals" because they are highly persistent and don't break down - causing damage to the environment, and serious health concerns for the human body.

The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) states that there is no safe level of PFAS exposure.

  • That's why we rigorously test our garments with SGS - a Swiss multinational company headquartered in Geneva.
  • Our BAER-Tex water-repellent coating is proven to be 100% free from PFAS and forever chemicals.
  • That's our commitment to keeping you, and the natural world, safe.

Freedom to Move for Outdoor Activities - From City Streets to Mountain Peaks.

Freedom to Move for Outdoor Activities - From City Streets to Mountain Peaks.

Our signature BÆRSkin Rain Jacket Fit is purpose-designed to accommodate activities like Fishing, Golf, Hunting, Camping or Boating. It's like wearing a shield against the rain that you can whip out whenever you need it most!

  • Slightly oversized to fit perfectly over shirts, sweaters or jackets.
  • Unisex design means it's the perfect all-season gift for your family, or the work team.
  • Ideal for working outdoors when the weather turns bad, you can get insulated in seconds.

Every Size, Measured Inch-Perfect.

Every Size, Measured Inch-Perfect.

Please note that our rain jacket is oversized to accommodate layering. To get your ideal size, take chest measurement and match it up with our sizing chart below — and remember, we also have easy exchanges and returns!

  • Step 1: Measure across your chest, under your armpits and around the back.
  • Step 2: Ensure that the tape is horizontal around the body, do not allow it to dip at the back.
  • Step 3: Match that measurement up with the size chart here and BOOM — the perfect fit is yours.
